extracted.intended_audience: interested parties and potential claimants to FTA project decisions; project sponsors; attorneys and other stakeholders tracking administrative/NEPA actions
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice announcing final FTA environmental decisions for a specific public transportation project and establishing the deadline and scope for judicial challenges under 23 U.S.C. 139(l). Targets procedural and documentary requirements for invoking or contesting those decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim filing deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: A claim seeking judicial review of FTA actions announced herein for the listed public transportation project will be barred unless the claim is filed on or before July 18, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The deadline is definitive: claims filed after this date are barred. See the DATES section of the notice for the filing cutoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of actions covered by the notice
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice applies to all FTA decisions on the listed project as of the issuance date and all laws under which such actions were taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically includes, but is not limited to, actions taken under NEPA (42 U.S.C. 4321-4347), Section 4(f) (49 U.S.C. 303), Section 106 of the NHPA (54 U.S.C. 306108), the Endangered Species Act (16 U.S.C. 1531), the Clean Water Act (33 U.S.C. 1251), the Uniform Relocation and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act (42 U.S.C. 4601), and the Clean Air Act (42 U.S.C. 7401-7671q).

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal authority invoked (statutory basis for limiting claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: The agency actions are subject to 23 U.S.C. 139(l) (authority cited: 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limitation on claims for the project is being activated under this statutory provision; challengers should assess how 23 U.S.C. 139(l) affects their ability to seek judicial review and the applicable statute of limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enumerated final agency actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The project actions that are the subject of this notice: Section 106 No Adverse Effect determination (dated November 21, 2025); Section 4(f) de minimis impact determination (dated January 16, 2026); Combined Final Environmental Impact Statement (FEIS)/Record of Decision (ROD) (dated January 30, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specific determinations are the final agency actions being announced and are the discrete decisions for which the limitation on claims is activated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting documentation availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting documents include the Combined FEIS/ROD (Jan 30, 2026), the Draft EIS (Aug 19, 2025), and other supporting documents; these can be viewed and downloaded from the project website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: URL provided for downloads: https://www.nftametrotransitexpansion.com/final_eis/. Interested parties should consult the FEIS/ROD, DEIS, and project environmental files to identify the administrative record and details of agency decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project description (defines what was approved)
rubrics_metrics.description: Buffalo-Amherst-Tonawanda Corridor Expansion Project: a seven-mile expansion of high-quality light rail transit service to Buffalo, Tonawanda and Amherst, including construction of ten stations, two park-and-ride facilities, and an overnight storage and maintenance facility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The project description defines the geographic scope and physical components of the action subject to the notice and is useful for determining standing, affected resources, and scope of any potential challenge.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain further information / contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact John Sautter, Attorney Advisor, Office of Chief Counsel, (212) 668-2180, or Saadat Khan, Environmental Protection Specialist, Office of Environmental Policy and Programs, (202) 366-6385; FTA address and office hours provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested parties may also contact the project sponsor or the relevant FTA Regional Office; contact information for Regional Offices is available at https://www.transit.dot.gov/about/regional-offices/regional-offices. Use these contacts to request records, clarifications, or procedural information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment status
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments are no longer being accepted for this notice; see the DATES section for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice explicitly states that public comments are closed for purposes of this limitation-on-claims notice. Also: this notice does not alter or extend limitation periods for challenges that were subject to prior Federal Register notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document drafting / mandatory Federal Register headings and metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings may include the agency or agencies issuing the document, the CFR title and part numbers affected (if any), the agency docket number/internal file number, and the RIN. The Federal Register document includes citation, document number, document type, pages, and publication date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Document Drafting Handbook for details; inclusion of these headings and metadata is standard for Federal Register notices and assists with legal citation, docket tracking, and locating supporting records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official publication and legal notice disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: FederalRegister.gov displays a prototype XML rendition and is not an official legal edition; use the linked PDF on govinfo.gov for the official electronic format. Until ACFR grants official status, the XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For legal research and litigation purposes verify contents against an official edition (GPO/govinfo). Only official editions provide legal notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect on prior notices
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice does not alter or extend the limitation period for challenges of project decisions subject to previous notices published in the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parties should review prior Federal Register notices concerning the project to determine whether separate limitation periods or prior deadlines apply to other decisions.
